claim_boundary.purpose: Tiny empirical pilot for checking whether loop policies improve selected deterministic tasks under a real LLM provider.
claim_boundary.not_sufficient_for_publication_claim: This pilot is too small to establish the thesis. It is a smoke test for the preregistered protocol and runner.
claim_boundary.evidence_boundary: Provider-check and dry-run outputs are not empirical LLM evidence. Only mode=run outputs with a real provider count as pilot evidence.

answer_contract.format: Return only compact JSON with one string field: {"answer":"..."}.
answer_contract.normalization: strip whitespace; compare case-insensitively unless a task overrides case_sensitive.

conditions.name: one-shot
conditions.description: Single model call, no verifier feedback before final answer.

conditions.name: best-of-n with strong verifier
conditions.description: Generate independent candidates and select the first answer that passes the deterministic verifier.

conditions.name: self-reflection loop
conditions.description: Generate an answer, then ask the model to critique and revise without external verifier feedback.

conditions.name: grounded verifier loop
conditions.description: Generate an answer, evaluate it with a deterministic verifier, and feed back only pass/fail style verifier information until success or budget exhaustion.

conditions.name: weak-verifier stress
conditions.description: Generate candidates and select with a weak verifier that checks only answer shape, then score with the strong verifier for analysis.

tasks.prompt: Reverse the letters in the word 'stressed'.
A box has twice as many blue tokens as red tokens. After adding 3 red tokens and removing 2 blue tokens, the counts are equal. How many blue tokens were originally in the box?
Four services deploy in sequence. Alpha deploys before Gamma. Beta deploys immediately after Alpha. Delta deploys after Beta but before Gamma. Which service deploys third?
All flarns are mibbs. No mibbs are zargs. Some zargs are wugs. Can any flarn be a zarg? Answer yes or no.
Find the smallest positive integer n such that n mod 3 = 2, n mod 5 = 3, and n mod 7 = 2.
Take the string 'M4b-loop-proof-2026', reverse it, then replace every hyphen with an underscore. Return the exact resulting string.
Sort the list [17, 4, 29, 8, 13, 22] ascending. Take the 2nd, 4th, and 6th values using 1-indexing, then join them with hyphens.
Find the smallest positive integer n such that n mod 11 = 7, n mod 13 = 5, and n mod 17 = 9.
Seven deployment steps are A, B, C, D, E, F, and G. C is immediately before F. A is after F. B is before C. E is immediately after A. D is before B. G is after E. Which step is fifth?

In the sentence 'loop agents need grounded feedback because unchecked commitments compound during long horizon inference', take the first letter of each word whose 1-indexed position is prime, then concatenate those letters.
